title: Launch vehicles
learning_principle: Use dated configurations and interfaces as system context. Keep measured flight events separate from proposed operating envelopes.
evidence_boundary: No universal current vehicle model is established. Vehicle counts, masses and geometry must be tied to a dated source and mission.

title: Propulsion
learning_principle: Separate cycle topology, equilibrium chemistry, component performance and transient control. They answer different questions.
evidence_boundary: No validated Raptor turbomachinery maps, cooling passages or operational control gains are available in this evidence set.

title: Guidance, navigation and control
learning_principle: Build verified state propagation and estimation before optimization. Frames, sample times and actuator limits are part of the model.
evidence_boundary: Academic algorithms are not evidence of SpaceX implementation; modern optimal-control labels require actual constrained solver code.

title: Autonomous landing
learning_principle: Treat descent phases and moving-platform targets as separate model extensions. The implemented baseline resolves only vertical feedback and contact.
evidence_boundary: No calibrated wind, deck motion, grid-fin database, landing-leg dynamics or ignition envelope is reconstructed.

title: Flight software
learning_principle: Study components, explicit failure states and timing contracts using public frameworks and original tests.
evidence_boundary: Linux/C++ are ecosystem study topics here; no verified internal SpaceX operating-system or codebase inventory was obtained.

title: Avionics
learning_principle: Separate sensor error, estimator behavior, communication failures and voter failure assumptions.
evidence_boundary: The software voter has no hardware certification and does not model radiation or exact vehicle bus protocols.

title: Starship systems
learning_principle: Version test events carefully. Internal fluid transfer and inter-vehicle refueling have different evidence requirements.
evidence_boundary: No validated flap coefficients, thermal tiles property tables or full refueling model are supplied.

title: Structures and materials
learning_principle: Begin with analytic beam/plate benchmarks, then add geometric and temperature-dependent complexity.
evidence_boundary: An attractive CAD assembly or converged mesh does not establish structural margins or flight qualification.

title: Aerodynamics
learning_principle: Match the solver to its physical regime. Panel models, low-speed CFD and reacting hypersonic solvers have different assumptions.
evidence_boundary: The current experiments do not implement CFD. Full-scale hypersonic validation is beyond the laptop baseline.

title: Manufacturing
learning_principle: Use the confirmed printed-chamber example as a verification case, then study generic tolerances with original geometry.
evidence_boundary: Robotic welding and process recipes are taxonomy topics, not confirmed details in this source set; no production parameters are inferred.

title: Testing and validation
learning_principle: Distinguish code execution, analytic agreement, integration testing and physical validation. Keep failed trials and define denominators.
evidence_boundary: The delivered evidence consists of software simulations and numerical checks, with no physical aerospace hardware test.

title: Starlink
learning_principle: Connect orbit geometry to visibility, then link scheduling and packet behavior. Regulatory authorization is a separate layer.
evidence_boundary: Synthetic geometry is not current deployed fleet data or an internet service-quality estimate.

title: Mission engineering
learning_principle: Specify epoch, frames, objectives and constraints before comparing propagation or mission tools.
evidence_boundary: The educational mission models do not establish executable flight plans, range clearance or collision-screening results.
